An extent of Ac.3.36 gts., in Sy.No. Lanka Khalsa.1, of Peddaravigudem Village,
Kukumuru Mandal, West Godavari District, which was acquired under the provisions
of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short the Act 30/2013), was the
subject matter of the dispute between the petitioner herein and the private
respondent.

2.

The 1st respondent herein filed W.P.No.16614 of 2018 contending that the compensation, payable under the said acquisition, was paid to the petitioner herein, and the representation dated 11.02.2017, of the 1st respondent, for payment of the said compensation, was rejected by the District Collector, by proceedings dated 15.03.2018 and the same requires to be corrected.

sentences.text: A learned Single Judge of this Court by a judgment dated 01.08.2023 had allowed the writ petition in the following manner.
"Accordingly, this writ petition is allowed, by setting aside the proceedings in Roc.NO.85/2016 dated 15.03.2018.

Respondent No.3 shall refer the matter to the Authority under Section 77 of the Act 30 of 2013, within a period of two (02) months,
from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

Respondent NO.3 shall also deposit the amount determined in Award proceedings (paid to 4th respondent) at the time of referring the matter to the authority as per Section 77 of the Act 30 of 2013."
4.
Aggrieved by this order, the petitioner herein had filed W.A.No.1307 of 2023, which came to be dismissed on 30.04.2024.
Aggrieved by the order of dismissal, the present review has been filed by the appellant.
5. A perusal of the grounds of review would show that these are grounds which do not arise for consideration in a review petition and are essentially grounds of appeal.
HCJ & RRR,J 6.

The learned counsel for the review petitioner, restricts himself to an error, that is said to have crept in the order of this Court dated 30.04.2024.
7.

The learned counsel would contend that the learned Single Judge, in paragraph 32 of his judgment, extracted above, had only directed the 3rd respondent, Land Acquisition Officer, to deposit the amount paid to the appellant herein whereas, this Court in paragraph 6, of the order dated 30.04.2024, had recorded that the learned Single Judge had directed redeposit of the compensation amount either by the Land Acquisition Officer or by the petitioner herein.

8. The learned counsel for the petitioner would contend that the said statement, recorded by this Court, to the extent of a direction that is said to have been given by the learned Single Judge against the petitioner for deposit of compensation amount, is an error apparent on the face of the record.
9. We have perused the order of the learned Single Judge as well as our order dated 30.04.2024.

We accept the contentions of the learned counsel that the direction, given by the learned Single Judge,
in paragraph-32 of his order dated 01.08.2023, was for the Land Acquisition Officer to deposit the compensation amount.
10. Accordingly, this review application is allowed and the words "either by the Land Acquisition Officer or by Sri S.T.V. Ramanujacharyulu" shall be read as "by the Land Acquisition Officer".
HCJ & RRR,J Registry is directed to issue amended copy of the order.
This is an application filed seeking stay of all further proceedings pursuant to the order, dated 30.04.2024, in W.A.No.1307 of 2023.
